transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, the main thing that pushed me to come in is work. I process insurance claims, and I just... I keep getting up from my workstation during the day. I know I’m supposed to stay put and finish my claim reviews, but I just can't seem to stay in my seat.
What is it that makes you feel like you have to get up from your seat?

I honestly don't really know. It's not like I feel restless or have this big physical urge to move around. I just... I guess I just lose track of what I'm doing. I'll get up to grab a coffee or some water, and I just kind of wander off from the claims. There isn't really one specific thing that makes me do it, I just find myself out of my chair.
Did you have similar difficulties with staying focused or keeping your mind on your work back when you were in school as a child?

Yeah, actually. Looking back, this isn't really brand new for me. Back in elementary school, my teachers used to write that I was a bright kid, but... I was always losing my worksheets. I'd miss instructions a lot, too, and they constantly had to give me reminders to actually finish my classwork.
Do you notice these kinds of difficulties causing problems for you outside of work, like in your home life or personal routines?

Honestly, I haven't really noticed it as much at home. I mean, work is where it really stands out because I have to sit there and get through a certain number of claims. At home, if I wander off while I'm doing something, it doesn't really matter as much, so it doesn't feel like a problem. So... no, nothing specific really comes to mind right now.
When you are working on those insurance claims, do you frequently find yourself overlooking details or making careless mistakes?

Not really, no. I mean, when I'm actually sitting down and looking at the claim, I do a pretty good job. The problem is more just staying in the chair and keeping at it, not so much messing up the details of the claims themselves. I haven't really had anyone tell me I'm making careless errors or anything like that.

Yeah, I definitely do. Especially since my caseload got bigger at work. My claim folders, my notes, all the email flags... they just end up all over the place. And then, because it's so scattered, I have a really hard time figuring out which policy review I need to tackle first.
While you're working, do you find yourself easily distracted by things happening around you or by unrelated thoughts?

Yeah, I do. If people near me start talking about another claim, or even if I just remember some random errand I need to run, my attention just... slides right off what I'm reading. Then I end up having to reread the exact same section a few times just to figure out what it actually said.
Do you often forget to do routine daily tasks, such as paying bills, keeping appointments, or running errands?

Yeah, I do. It happens at work a lot, actually. I forget simple follow-ups way more than I want to admit. Like, I'll mean to return a claimant's call, or I need to update a diary note on a file, or send out a specific form... and I just completely forget to do it later in the day. It just slips my mind.
